entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: ResourceBoundsFromEnv runs once at process startup to resolve the CERBERUS_PROMQL_*_MAX_COST_UNITS overrides (issue #2667); a non-positive override fails cerberus startup, it is never reachable from a query a client sends
